title: 第21章 活鬼神像第22章 多多关照
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 第三次上山，王易感觉像回到了自己家一样。
人杰地灵，路熟门儿清，邻里街坊一个都不认识。
哦，也不对。
他在山上还是有两个熟人的，比如凉亭内蹲坑守门的刘启元师兄，以及任务大殿里招揽客人的柳笙笙师姐。
不过这一世，王易选择避开两位老熟人，去结识几个新的朋友。
原因很简单，他喜新厌旧，不念旧情，打算洁身自好，远离前世糜烂堕落的生活。
“柳师姐的红楼简直是销魂魔窟，那种地方去一次就够了，我今生虔心修道，没有世俗的欲望……”
王易目不斜视的路过红楼，去了更高处，太一宗的藏书阁。
自己该读读书了，陶冶情操，增长见识。
人享受过销魂蚀骨，就进入了圣贤时间。
王易对自己更狠，进入角色之后，简直比圣人还圣人，几乎丢掉了外欲。
第一天他下山，向陈清月转述了一下山上的情况。
两人商量对策，最后还是决定暗中观察，见机行事，走了第三世的路子。
从第二天开始，王易整个人就不对劲了。
他住进了藏书阁，关进小楼，不问西东。
“读书，增长见识！”
“看画，陶冶情操！”
王易像一个勤劳刻苦的书生，如饥似渴的沉浸在知识的海洋中。
他看的书很杂，大部分都是关于东南七国和海外邪修的人物志，看的地图，涉及各大宗派管辖的区域划分。
王易是初入修行界的新人，他想在有限的时间里，尽可能对这个修行界有更多的了解。
“方便日后惹是生非，拔腿跑路！”
有什么不明白的地方，就下山去请教师姐。
陈清月也很意外，没想到王易会如此上进好学，一心向道。
从陈家府里逃出来的少年奴隶，似乎格外珍惜这个改变命运的机会。
他天赋不错，性格谨慎低调，更没有被山上那些纸醉金迷和莺莺燕燕迷了眼……假以时日，说不定还真能在修行界有一番作为。
但会有吗？
陈清月想了想，觉得好像不会。
因为王易是被自己领上山的，一只无辜的替罪羊。
不管太一宗日后如何，王易都很难在这里活下去，邪修不会放过他，太一宗也不会饶恕这个知情不报的小角色。
到那个时候，陈清月早就取走黑莲仙缘，远走高飞了。
“是我害了他。”
陈清月心中有点过意不去，当然也只有那么一点点，可以忽略不计。
——人都有良知，修仙者少一些，还要警惕良知带来的危害和代价。
王易对此却好像一无所知。
他上山下山，心无旁骛，浑然不觉死期将至。
这种情况一直到十天后，太一宗庆典逼近，弟子陆续返宗回山。
王易才老老实实的留在了山下，待在破庙内。
“我发现修行不是一件容易事。”
王易坐在屋檐下，深深的叹了口气。
陈清月抬了抬眼，心想这不是废话吗。
修士逆天而行，与天争寿，炼气十三层圆满和凡人无异，只能活一百余岁。筑基修士有两百多年的寿元，金丹修士五百年起步。
只有传说中的婴仙才能跨过千年寿元的枷锁，但具体能活多久也没什么人知道。
content_en:
Going up the mountain for the third time, Wang Yi felt like he was back at home.
The people are outstanding, the streets are familiar and the houses are clear, and no one in the neighborhood knows anyone.
Oh, that's not right either.
He still has two acquaintances on the mountain, such as Senior Brother Liu Qiyuan who is guarding the pavilion, and Senior Sister Liu Shengsheng who is recruiting guests in the mission hall.
But in this life, Wang Yi chose to avoid two old acquaintances and make a few new friends.
The reason is very simple. He likes the new and hates the old. He does not miss the old feelings and intends to keep clean and stay away from the corrupt and decadent life of his previous life.
"Senior Sister Liu's Red Mansion is simply a den of ecstasy. Going to that kind of place once is enough. I am devoted to cultivating Taoism in this life and have no worldly desires..."
Wang Yi passed by the red building without squinting and went to a higher place, the library pavilion of Taiyi Sect.
It's time for you to read, cultivate your sentiments and increase your knowledge.
Once a person has enjoyed the ecstasy of soul and corroded bones, he has entered the time of sages.
Wang Yi is even more cruel to himself. After entering the role, he is simply more saint than a saint, almost giving up his external desires.
On the first day, he went down the mountain and relayed the situation on the mountain to Chen Qingyue.
The two discussed countermeasures, and finally decided to observe secretly, act according to the opportunity, and took the path of the third life.
Starting from the next day, Wang Yi's whole person felt wrong.
He lived in the Library Pavilion and was locked up in a small building. He didn't care about the west or the east.
"Read and gain knowledge!"
"Look at paintings and cultivate your sentiments!"
Wang Yi is like a hard-working scholar, eagerly immersed in the ocean of knowledge.
The books he read were very miscellaneous, most of which were chronicles of the seven southeastern countries and overseas evil cultivators. The maps he read involved the division of areas under the jurisdiction of various major sects.
Wang Yi is a newcomer to the world of practice. He wants to learn as much as possible about this world of practice in the limited time.
"It will make it easier for you to cause trouble in the future and run away!"
If you don’t understand something, go down the mountain and ask your teacher.
Chen Qingyue was also surprised. She didn't expect Wang Yi to be so motivated, eager to learn, and devoted to the Tao.
The young slave who escaped from the Chen family seemed to cherish this opportunity to change his destiny.
He has a good talent, a cautious and low-key personality, and he is not blinded by the drunken and glamorous people on the mountain...given time, maybe he can really make a difference in the world of spiritual practice.
But will there be?
Chen Qingyue thought about it and felt that it wouldn't be possible.
Because Wang Yi was led up the mountain by himself, an innocent scapegoat.
No matter what happens to the Taiyi Sect in the future, it will be difficult for Wang Yi to survive here. The evil cultivator will not let him go, and the Taiyi Sect will not forgive this little character who knows nothing about it.
By that time, Chen Qingyue would have already taken away the Black Lotus Immortal Fate and flew away.
"I hurt him."
Chen Qingyue felt a little bit regretful, but of course it was only a little bit and could be ignored.
——Everyone has a conscience, but there are fewer cultivators of immortality. We must also be wary of the harm and costs caused by conscience.
Wang Yi seemed to know nothing about this.
He went up and down the mountain without any distractions, unaware that his death was approaching.
This situation lasted until ten days later, when the Taiyi Sect celebration was approaching, and the disciples returned to the sect and returned to the mountain one after another.
Wang Yicai stayed at the foot of the mountain and stayed in the ruined temple.
…
"I found that spiritual practice is not an easy task."
Wang Yi sat under the eaves and sighed deeply.
Chen Qingyue raised her eyes, wondering if this was nonsense.
The monks go against the will of heaven and compete with the heavens for longevity. After reaching the thirteenth level of Qi refining, they are no different from ordinary people. They can only live for more than a hundred years. The foundation-building monks have a lifespan of more than two hundred years, and the golden elixir monks have a lifespan of five hundred years.
Only the legendary infant immortals can overcome the shackles of a thousand years of life, but no one knows exactly how long they can live.
